The resulting clock frequencies must be accurate to within 0.1 %; wait for each oscillator/PLL to be ready before using it and for the clock switch to take effect (busy-wait on the status flags). Answer with one complete C code block (`#include "stm32g4xx.h"`, then a `main()` that configures everything and finally loops forever with `while (1)`), followed by a short explanation.
